description: This file contains server-side code for the 'ShowAns.aspx' page in an online examination system. It handles displaying student's answers to questions, submitting updated marks, and navigation actions. It interacts with a SQL database to fetch and update student answer data and manages session control for user identification.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ShowAns.aspx page, managing display and update of student answers in the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load; retrieves student answers from database for questions 1 to 5 based on session info and displays them.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks from input fields, updates database with student's marks and approval status, removes the student from course queue, optionally updates admin queue, and navigates to course queue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and navigates to the login page.
